body:
The isolated single-invocation portable-normal Endpoint candidate is **rejected** under the unchanged original cost gates. Canonical source remains `630844e775a85e74eb5d9ed328a2b8019abb640d`; no production selection or PR 62 source changed.

Original first Endpoint control passed all four precision routes and 56 complete readbacks. Original integrated interval control also passed (89.753 s, 300 s governor), with all 32 complete readbacks equal to the preserved original baseline. Thus 2/8 original controls completed. The remaining 6 were deliberately not run after the cost rejection.

One frozen current matched A1/B1/B2/A2 trial ran once, with the original three repeats per family and 300 s / 4 GiB / 2 GiB reserve/cache-off controls. Both arms used the same established passive observer object and ordinary production device features. All four slots completed with zero numerical failures; all 32 whole readbacks matched across slots, and all 54 command/module joins per slot matched actual linked-array authority.

Only **2/20** original whole-call/stage gates and **1/2** provisioning-inclusive API gates passed. Whole-call improvements (negative means slower) were forward legacy−19.1405%, modern−25.4512%; reverse legacy−111.9984%, modern−228.4946%. API improvements were +11.0829% and−124.9457%. No pooling, excluded candidate costs, thresholds, retries or warmups were introduced. The first paired compile/link succeeded but its provenance reader refused an unsealed standard-library header; its negative owner is retained. The corrected manifest covering 520 dependencies preceded a fresh strict build and every timing slot.

The prior actual called-code capture removed coroutine resume state, but emitted text grew 5.48%. Coroutine removal did not suffice to pass the original end-to-end gates. No exact-candidate rerun, remaining-six-control run, frame attempt, adoption, full-science or release claim follows this result. The captured entry still contains eight-wide vector operations while this module declares LocalSize 1; investigating cross-ray execution would require a distinct storage/ownership design and a new compiler admission, not another trial of this version.

Immutable checkpoint: [121db07cabe4508890c3ba3045bfe040805df8be](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/commit/121db07cabe4508890c3ba3045bfe040805df8be), tag `evidence/software-single-invocation-endpoint-cost-630844e7`, branch `development/software-single-invocation-2026-10-20`. Bundle: `attestations/qualification/630844e7/software-single-invocation-endpoint-cost` (readable comparison/decision plus 119-file closed archive); original 283-file source/JIT/first-control checkpoint remains linked. Issue 44 and all original acceptance remain open.
